purpose: Stage 2 drug-perturbation model candidate (deployed): Squidiff diffusion model

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git

note: manifest, verified_at, verify_result and tree_sha256 are filled by ticket 09; asset files/bytes are subsets of the source/ tree recorded on repository entries
notes: Deployed model; the repository ships code but no weights. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: create_model(gene_size=500, num_layers=2, output_dim=500, use_encoder=True, use_drug_structure=True, drug_dimension=1024) -> 43,342,384 params; forward at (4,500) returns (4,500); the drug input is an rFCFP fingerprint multiplied by log10(dose+1) with no separate dose covariate; gene size is configurable. LICENSE still contains unresolved merge-conflict markers, both sides BSD-3 (azizilab 2022 / Siyu He 2024). Released checkpoints are FigShare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.27948633 (manual, not downloaded).
